newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management sells preferred for $21 million.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management sells preferred for $21 million.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Monday it has sold 21,000 shares of series A convertible preferred stock to two institutional investors for $21 million in gross proceeds.

The stock will accrue dividends at a rate of six percent a year payable in cash or kind, Metal Management said. It can be converted into Metal Managment common stock at a price per common share equal to the lesser of $18.30 or 85 percent of the average market price per share of the company's stock for the five days preceding the notice of conversion.
Subject to certain conditions, the preferred stock must be converted on the third anniversary of the closing, the company said. The shares issuable on conversion are subject to shareholder approval.
Metal Management said net proceeds from the sale were $20 million. The company intends to use the proceeds principally to fund future acquisitions and to repay debt.
